name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-06-15.44.1) introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), which related to an inquiry into the [Migration Amendment (Giving Documents and Other Measures) Bill 2023](Migration Amendment (Giving Documents and Other Measures) Bill 2023). ### Senator McKim's amendment > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the Migration Amendment (Giving Documents and Other Measures) Bill 2023, the bill be referred immediately to the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 31 July 2023".*
